business_summary: Tameny Inc. provides marriage support and casual wedding services in Japan. It operates through Matchmaking Business; Casual Wedding Business; and Regional Revitalization/Q0L Business segments. The company engages in the operation of marriage consultation offices; planning, development, and operation of matchmaking parties and online matchmaking services; mutual member introduction platforms between matchmaking businesses; and production of casual wedding ceremonies and receptions, small weddings, wedding ceremony unveiling parties, photo weddings, and wedding after-parties. It is also involved in the provision of support services for women's activities and local governments, including matchmaking support systems, operation of matchmaking support centers, and hosting of various events and seminars. In addition, the company offers life, non-life, and wedding insurance products, as well as small-amount short-term insurance; and real estate and financial product brokerage services. It provides its services under the Partner Agent, OTOCON, Partner Agent App, Smakon Date, CONNECT-ship, Konkatsu Alliance Partners, Roughsta, studio LUMINOIS, 2jikai-kun, and Anniversary Club names. The company was formerly known as Partner Agent, Inc. and changed its name to Tameny Inc. in September 2020. Tameny Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
